I was looking for flat on rent. Came across an agent named, Sanjay Mane through magicbricks.com.  He introduced me to Julliet another agent. Julliet stays in the same building.
They showed me a 1BHK flat in the first floor (Flat-101). The flat is owned by Christopher Fernandez and his wife Valensia Fernandez.
I paid the security deposit before entering into the flat and half of the brokerage. Sanjay kept on pushing me for the remaining brokerage but he kept on procrastinating to turn up during the registration.
Now the second part. Despite having police clearance and prior informing to the society president, I wasn't allowed to enter into the building, claiming my owner didn't pay the maintenance bill. It was the society president who asked the security guard not to allow me to enter the building, she went to church and turned off her mobile.
I was assured of 24 hours water. There is water but its' boring water not BMC supplied. Later came to know that the Building didn't have OC.
I was assured of parking space. the owner do have parking space but you can't avail it as the main gate was broken. If you try to park the car outside the building (which is under government control), people will say I do park my car here, you have to remove it else I will damage your car. Eventually, my car was punctured. When I went to meet the secretary, she didn't bother to come outside of her flat.
When contacted Valensia  she said her husband is out of the country once he comes he will sort that out, which was never sorted.
the flat has leakage problem, despite reminding the owner dozens of times, he didn't do anything.
One day, we found the lock of our main door was tampered, no one including the security guard has any clue on who did that.
I contacted Sanjay Mane, but he never thought of giving a visit.
Finally after 3 months of stay, I decided to vacate the flat. Owner decided to cut money for the door lock and lots of money to repaint the house, cause due to the leakage.
Now folks, you have decide, do you really want to get into this mess and waste your hard earned money. I would recommend you to stay in some SRA flat over Celebration apartment. You can't celebrate your stay over there coz you will be obliterated.
Good luck folks and take care.

This project was stalled for over 10 years. It was initially developed by a local builder, but due to irregularities in handling slum rehabilitation—particularly issues around vacating residents and unpaid rent—the project faced serious disputes. Some of the original residents still live around the site, and the area continues to have local tensions. This is also one of the reasons nearby commercial outlets, like Pizza Hut, are no longer operational.

The original allottees under the slum rehab plan have still not received their designated homes, which poses potential risks for new buyers. Additionally, the building’s core design and structure were developed by the initial builder before being taken over by a larger real estate group, raising concerns about construction quality. This history is one reason many flats remain unsold.
